sandbachFocus: League leaders Sandbach United travel to Alsager Town on Saturday 3 October (15:00) in what should be a straightforward fixture given Alsager's position at the foot of the table with just 4 points from 10 games. Sandbach, who recently suffered a loss but remain top with 22 points from 10 matches, will be looking to bounce back and extend their lead over second-placed Stafford Town.
divisionWide: Saturday's action features a competitive top-of-the-table clash as second-placed Stafford Town (20 points) host third-placed Dawley Town, a crucial fixture in the title race. AFC Bridgnorth, currently third with 19 points despite recent losses, face a home match against Eccleshall (18 points), who have won their last outing. In-form Wolverhampton Casuals (19 points, recently on a three-game winning streak) travel to face Wednesfield Community at home, while Bilston Town (17 points, unbeaten in their last three) visit Foley Meir. The midtable picture sees Barnton host Shawbury United—Barnton having won their last two while Shawbury endure a run of six consecutive defeats. Crewe face Allscott Heath in a lower-mid-table encounter, while Market Drayton Town travel to New Mills in a fixture between sides seeking consistency. Cheadle Heath Nomads (7 points) visit Telford Town (6 points) in a basement clash, and Brereton Social host Widnes Town (2 points, pointless away from home). Midweek on Wednesday 7 October, Brereton Social host Wednesfield Community in a standalone fixture.
